newsitem.title: CHINA: ING Bank wins suit against local Shanghai firm.
newsitem.headline: ING Bank wins suit against local Shanghai firm.

text.p: ING Bank N.V. has won a court ruling in Shanghai's first loan contract dispute between a foreign bank and a Chinese firm, an ING Bank official said on Tuesday.

The official Liberation Daily said the city's First Intermediate Court had ordered a local trading firm to repay an overdue three-month loan of HK$5.29 million issued in January 1995, as well as 34,000 yuan in interest and economic losses to ING Bank.
A court official said the ruling was made in late December 1996.

"I would say that ING Bank's experience in pursuing repayment of facilities has been highly satisfactory, and our experience with the court system has also been highly satisfactory," said an ING bank official in Shanghai.
But another bank official said it would probably take another three years to recover the money, adding that the lack of a precedent had made it difficult to resolve the dispute.
"We hope that new regulations will arise because of the case," the second official said.
Neither the newspaper nor the ING officials named the Chinese company concerned.
